sentences.text: Let's get Notchy installed.
You'll need macOS 14 or later.
Head to the Notchy page on GitHub, open Releases, and download the zip file.
Double-click the zip to unzip it.
Then drag Notchy into your Applications folder.
The first time you open it, macOS says it can't verify Notchy.
That's expected.
Go to System Settings, Privacy and Security, and click Open Anyway.
Next, a quick welcome.
Step one: hover the notch to open it.
Step two: allow only what you use.
Each Allow button opens the right spot in System Settings.
Skip one, and that feature just stays off.
Step three: pick your tabs.
Want a menu bar icon?
Switch it on here.
Notchy hooks into your AI coding agent for you.
It backs up your old settings file first.
You can turn it off in Settings, under General.
To open Settings, right-click the notch and choose Settings.
You can also use the menu bar icon, or just open Notchy again from Applications.
Want to remove it?
Turn off the coding agent integration in Settings, quit from the notch menu, and drag Notchy to the Trash.
That's it.
Enjoy Notchy.
